plugins.name: mjonir-daytrader
plugins.description: Thirteen Claude skills for day trading: upstream's eleven (a chart scanner, a news monitor, an entry timer, an exit planner, a time machine, a risk manager, a budget manager, an order executor that never acts without your yes, price alerts, an earnings analyst and a Pelosi tracker) plus a forward record and a daily desk, being moved onto the Massive market-data API. Not financial advice.
